raw_response:
1. The figure shows no error bars on the DeepSeek bar (or any bar), so it does not provide evidence about variability or instability relative to other models.

2. The figure labels ChatGPT at 190 seconds (not ~230) versus 77 seconds for our Joint Framework, so our method is 113 seconds faster (~2.5×). Whether this meets a “real-time streaming” threshold isn’t specified in the figure, so it can’t be concluded from this plot alone.

3. No statistical test results, sample sizes, or variance estimates are shown, so a p-value for the difference between our Joint Framework (77s) and LLaMA (172s) cannot be determined from the figure; it only shows a 95-second runtime reduction. Without significance testing and application-specific criteria, “meaningful improvement” can’t be statistically asserted from this chart alone.
